name: Vallbona de les Monges (Spain)
description: Light blue field with a central white pale flanked on each side by a narrow black pale.
history: The official flag of Vallbona de les Monges is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light blue, with a central white pale of thickness 2/9 of the length of the cloth and a black pale of thickness 1/18 juxtaposed on each side; approved on 10 July 2009 and published in the DOGC on 17 September 2009.

features.role: central white pale of 2/9 with a narrow black pale juxtaposed on each side
